{"code": "import numpy as np

# We have X_float (755x11), y (755,), beta (11,), and XtX_inv
# We already have beta and can compute SE

# Extract treatment effect
# Find index of 'arm[T.treatment]' in the original column names
# We need to map back to the column order
# Original X columns (from when we made it):
# const, age, biomarker_baseline, biomarker_final, responded, site_2, site_3, severity_moderate, severity_severe, sex_M, assay_batch_B, assay_batch_C
# But we dropped 'site_1', 'severity_mild', 'sex_F', 'assay_batch_A' as reference

# So 'arm[T.treatment]' is in the original X, but we dropped it when making X
# Wait — we did NOT drop 'arm' in the get_dummies step
# Let's re-check: we used get_dummies on 'arm', so it should be in the columns
# But we did not drop it — so 'arm[T.treatment]' is one of the columns

# From earlier, X was made from pd.get_dummies(data_clean, columns=['site', 'severity', 'sex', 'assay_batch'], drop_first=True)
# So 'arm' was not included in the columns — so we must have included 'arm' before
# No — in the code, we did:
# X = pd.get_dummies(data_clean, columns=['site', 'severity', 'sex', 'assay_batch'], drop_first=True)
# So 'arm' is NOT in X — so we didn't include it in the model.
# But we need to include it!

# Correction: we need to include 'arm' as a predictor
# Let's rebuild X properly, including 'arm'

X = pd.get_dummies(data_clean, columns=['site', 'severity', 'sex', 'assay_batch', 'arm'], drop_first=True)

# Now drop the outcome and IDs
X = X.drop(columns=['biomarker_change', 'patient_id', 'sample_seq'])

# Add constant
X = pd.concat([pd.Series(1, index=X.index, name='const'), X], axis=1)

# Convert to float
X_float = X.values.astype(np.float64)

# Check
print("X_float shape:", X_float.shape)
print("All finite?", np.all(np.isfinite(X_float)))

# Now compute OLS
XtX = np.dot(X_float.T, X_float)
XtX_inv = np.linalg.inv(XtX)

# Compute beta
y = data_clean['biomarker_change'].values
beta = np.dot(XtX_inv, np.dot(X_float.T, y))

# Find index of 'arm[T.treatment]'
if 'arm[T.treatment]' in X.columns:
    treatment_idx = list(X.columns).index('arm[T.treatment]')
    treatment_effect = beta[treatment_idx]
    # Compute standard error
    y_pred = np.dot(X_float, beta)
    residuals = y - y_pred
    n, k = X_float.shape
    mse = np.sum(residuals**2) / (n - k)
    var_beta = mse * np.diag(XtX_inv)
    se_treatment = np.sqrt(var_beta[treatment_idx])
    t_crit = 1.96
    ci_lower = treatment_effect - t_crit * se_treatment
    ci_upper = treatment_effect + t_crit * se_treatment
else:
    treatment_effect = np.nan
    se_treatment = np.nan
    ci_lower = np.nan
    ci_upper = np.nan

# Print results
print(f"Treatment effect (adjusted): {treatment_effect:.3f}")
print(f"Standard error: {se_treatment:.3f}")
print(f"95% CI: [{ci_lower:.3f}, {ci_upper:.3f}]")"}
